# 16. Reliability

## Content of Reliability Test

<table>
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th colspan="4">Environmental Test</th>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <th>Test Item</th>
      <th>Content of Test</th>
      <th>Test Condition</th>
      <th>Applicable Standard</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr>
      <td>High Temperature storage</td>
      <td>Endurance test applying the high storage temperature for a long time.</td>
      <td>80°C 96hrs</td>
      <td>____</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td>Low Temperature storage</td>
      <td>Endurance test applying the high storage temperature for a long time.</td>
      <td>-30°C 96hrs</td>
      <td>____</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td>High Temperature Operation</td>
      <td>Endurance test applying the electric stress (Voltage & Current) and the thermal stress to the element for a long time.</td>
      <td>70°C 96hrs</td>
      <td>____</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td>Low Temperature Operation</td>
      <td>Endurance test applying the electric stress under low temperature for a long time.</td>
      <td>-20°C 96hrs</td>
      <td>____</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td>High Temperature/Humidity Storage</td>
      <td>Endurance test applying the high temperature and high humidity storage for a long time.</td>
      <td>80°C,90%RH 96hrs</td>
      <td>____</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td>High Temperature/Humidity Operation</td>
      <td>Endurance test applying the electric stress (Voltage & Current) and temperature / humidity stress to the element for a long time.</td>
      <td>70°C,90%RH 96hrs</td>
      <td>____</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td>Temperature Cycle</td>
      <td>Endurance test applying the low and high temperature cycle.<br>-30°C 25°C 80°C<br>30min 5min 30min<br>1 cycle</td>
      <td>-30°C→80°C<br>10 cycles</td>
      <td>____</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <th colspan="4">Mechanical Test</th>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td>Vibration test</td>
      <td>Endurance test applying the vibration during transportation and using.</td>
      <td>10~22Hz→1.5mmp-p<br>22~500Hz→1.5G<br>Total 0.5hrs</td>
      <td>____</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td>Shock test</td>
      <td>Constructional and mechanical endurance test applying the shock during transportation.</td>
      <td>50G Half sign wave 11 msedc<br>3 times of each direction</td>
      <td>____</td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>

***Supply voltage for logic system=5V. Supply voltage for LCD system =Operating voltage at 25°C
